title: Home
text:
University of British Columbia
Advancing science for sustainable and resilient oceans in a changing climate.
Research Publications Leadership




My research examines how climate change is transforming marine ecosystems, fisheries, biodiversity, and ocean-dependent communities. I develop and apply interdisciplinary models, scenarios, and assessments to identify risks, adaptation options, and pathways toward sustainable ocean futures.


Understanding how warming, ocean extremes, deoxygenation, acidification, and changes in circulation affect marine biodiversity and ecosystem functioning.



Assessing the future of fisheries and aquatic food systems under climate change and exploring pathways that support food security, equity, and sustainability.



Connecting ecological change with conservation, governance, and sustainable development across local to global scales.



Contributing scientific evidence and assessment leadership through international processes including the IPCC and IPBES.





I lead the Changing Ocean Research Unit, an interdisciplinary research group at the University of British Columbia.
